analyst.summary: Avanti Feeds is India's largest shrimp-feed and processing company, whose stock and recent growth suffered under a severe 50% US tariff on Indian shrimp exports. That tariff was cut to 18% in February 2026, materially improving the competitive and earnings outlook, and FY26 results already show revenue and profit growth resuming with expanding margins. We are upgrading the quant model's Sell signal to a Hold given this concrete, dated de-risking catalyst.
